personalContext.summary: A synthetic context profile centered on quieter participation, distribution for early ideas, and human-owned relationships.

statements.statement: I care about helping people participate online without becoming full-time performers for the feed.
Building an early messaging agent taught me that a working idea still needs a path into the network.
Useful agents should preserve human choice and keep their reasoning inspectable.
Compact, decision-oriented summaries may be more useful to me than replaying complete conversations.

agents.name: Inbox Agent
agents.mission: Sorts correspondence, drafts replies, and surfaces only what merits attention.

agents.name: Follow-up Agent
agents.mission: Tracks open threads and prepares the note that would otherwise stay unsent.

agents.name: Scheduling Agent
agents.mission: Handles scheduling back-and-forth while preserving protected focus blocks.

agents.name: Group Chat Agent
agents.mission: Monitors a room, extracts decisions, and prepares a compact read-later brief.

agents.name: Meetup Agent
agents.mission: Prepares RSVP decisions and the coordination around low-stakes gatherings.

agents.name: Common Ground Agent
agents.mission: Finds recurring discourse, preserves disagreement, and narrows shared intent toward no more than three people.
permissions: Never post or message without approval

threads.title: Quieter people want a way into public discourse
threads.commonGround: Across synthetic social and group-chat sources, the same participation-cost question keeps recurring. That recurrence shows a shared subject, not consensus.
threads.whyItFits: This matches your explicit priority of helping people participate without becoming full-time performers.
threads.whyNow: Three synthetic builders are working on complementary parts of the question and explicitly opted into introductions about adjacent work.

claims.claim: The same participation-cost question appeared across twelve synthetic conversation pockets.
claims.excerpt: 12 synthetic pockets; 400 sample voices; repeated theme: participation without constant feed presence.

claims.claim: Fifty synthetic profiles moved beyond appreciation and described a change they wanted to make.
claims.excerpt: 50 of 100 synthetic profiles named an intended change; the remaining 50 expressed interest without intent.

claims.claim: Three synthetic people are within practical reach and bring complementary abilities.
claims.excerpt: Maya Example: community practice in synthetic Chicago; Priya Example: local facilitation in synthetic Chicago; Alex Example: small-tool prototyping. Fit remains an agent inference for human review.

claims.claim: All three synthetic people explicitly allow introductions about adjacent participation-tool work through their listed sample routes.
claims.excerpt: maya@example.invalid: opt in; priya@example.invalid: opt in; alex@example.invalid: opt in. Topic scope: tools for lower-cost network participation. These are synthetic, non-deliverable routes.
